camel_example: aliyun eiam SetPasswordExpirationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordExpirationStatus enabled --PasswordExpirationNotificationChannels.1 login --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PasswordForcedUpdateDuration 7 --EffectiveAuthenticationSourceIds.1 ia_passwordxxxx --PasswordValidMaxDay 180 --PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration 7 --PasswordExpirationAction force_update_password --PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus enabled --method POST --force
description_en: Sets the password expiration policy for a specified Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) instance
description_zh: 设置指定EIAM实例下密码过期策略
kebab_example: aliyun eiam set-password-expiration-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-expiration-status enabled --password-valid-max-day 180 --password-expiration-action force_update_password --password-expiration-notification-status enabled --password-expiration-notification-channels login --password-expiration-notification-duration 7 --password-forced-update-duration 7 --effective-authentication-source-ids ia_passwordxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPasswordExpirationConfiguration

parameters.description_en:
The password expiration configuration status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.
parameters.description_zh:
密码过期配置状态，取值可选范围：
- enabled：开启。
- disabled：禁用。

parameters.name: password_expiration_status

parameters.description_en: The validity period of a password, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled.
parameters.description_zh: 密码有效时长，单位是天。当PasswordExpirationStatus取值为enabled时必传。
parameters.help_en: The validity period of a password, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled

parameters.description_en:
The action to take when a password expires. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:
- forbid\_login: Prohibit logon.
- force\_update\_password: Force password change.
- remind\_update\_password: Remind to change password.
parameters.description_zh:

- remind\_update\_password：提醒修改密码。
